task_summary: Build a single-page D3.js v6 web app with a force-simulation bubble chart (sector-clustered, market-cap-sized) and an interactive data table, connected via click highlighting, using Python to generate all output files.
decomposition_rationale: The task has two distinct concerns: (1) Python-side orchestration to set up the output directory, copy data, fetch D3.js, and generate the HTML/CSS/JS files, and (2) the actual D3.js visualization logic (force simulation, bubble chart, table, interactions). Splitting these keeps file-generation logic separate from the complex visualization code, making each skill focused and reusable.

skills.name: evo-web-scaffold-generator
skills.description: Python utility that creates the output directory structure, copies input data, downloads d3.v6.min.js locally, and writes the index.html and style.css files for the stock visualization dashboard.
skills.responsibility: Directory setup, data copying, D3.js library fetching, HTML boilerplate generation, and CSS stylesheet creation. Does NOT contain visualization logic.
dr_sections: 7. Python Utility Functions for File Generation

skills.name: evo-d3v6-stock-visualization
skills.description: Generates the complete visualization.js file implementing a D3.js v6 force-simulation bubble chart with sector clustering, an interactive data table, tooltips, legends, and bidirectional click-based highlighting between chart and table.
skills.responsibility: All D3.js v6 client-side visualization logic: CSV loading/parsing, force simulation setup (forceX/forceY/forceCollide), scaleSqrt for bubble sizing, ordinal color scale for sectors, legend rendering, tooltip with v6 event handling, HTML table generation with formatted market cap, and bidirectional click interaction with scroll-into-view.

5. D3.js v6 Interactive Data Table with Click-Based Highlighting

5.2 Custom Number Formatting: Replacing G with B
6. D3.js v6 Text Labels Inside Circles
